summary: Completed live backend and mobile browser regression testing for registration, session cookies, dashboard protection, persistent Cashless/Reimbursement claims, invalid login handling, and logout.

minor.issue: No brute-force lockout or rate limiting is implemented after repeated failed attempts; review as a security hardening item.

action_items: Consider login rate limiting or account lockout after five failed attempts.
Attention/deadline dashboard content remains seeded as intentionally mocked prototype data.
Navigation and document upload controls remain presentation/toast-only until those modules are implemented.
seed_data_creation: Created one uniquely named regression household and two claims through public APIs; no seeded records modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live preview https://policy-shield-8.preview.emergentagent.com passed registration, protected workspace, both claim types, persistence after dashboard reload, safe invalid login, and logout on 390px mobile. No password_hash or MongoDB _id leaked in tested responses.
rca of the issue: The tested flows are real MongoDB-backed endpoints and passed. The missing brute-force protection is visible in the login implementation: every failed credential attempt immediately returns 401 with no counter, delay, or lockout state. Attention/deadline content is explicitly returned as seeded dashboard arrays and should be treated as MOCKED prototype content.
